project_title: Machine Learning Enhanced Graph-Based Anomaly Detection for Financial Transactions
purpose: Scoring-behavior and compute decision gate; no fraud-accuracy evaluation
affine: source-binary-iqr-affine-v1; median and binary IQR scale fitted to saved source-training scores; source range then unit fallback; strict numerical order check
fusion: raw-affine-crest-feasibility-v1; D=mean family median delta_z; R=mean eligible family 1/(1+median absolute delta_z); H=z+alpha*D-beta*max(z,0)*(1-R); no clipping; missing required statistic falls back to z
cohort: Held-out scores sorted ascending, lexical ID tie-break, three equal-size rank strata. Choose two per stratum in SHA256(seed,stratum,ID) order, requiring >=2 historical events and >=1 feasible frozen candidate; no labels
family_cap: Two accepted per family; original seeded greedy budgeted family yields at most one
random_control: One uniform subset with matching omitted count per accepted structured candidate, sampled without replacement, conditioned on all identical budget ceilings. At most 128 rejection attempts; identical subsets permitted and overlap reported
feature_path: indexed-focal-features-global-centrality-v1; original global sampled/exact NetworkX policy retained
reference_checks: Baseline full matrix once, first accepted structured candidate per account versus full reference; one uncached replay per score stratum
projection_policy: Measured 5K pilot per-account costs projected to 250, 500, 1500 accounts with explicit sample/eligibility bias. For ~50K, same-cost scenario only, not a validated runtime estimate; original 10000-node reference guard retained
labels: Never accessed by pilot, selection, calibration, fusion, controls or gate. No detection metrics
outputs: New append-only data/results/v2 directory; completion manifest last; failed/timeout outputs marked incomplete
